One of the most sought-after objects in the world and the centrepiece of the emblem. Not in an abstracted, or cartoonish form, but in an ultra-realistic expression that is true to the sculptural quality of the trophy itself.

memories.text: This emblem makes the year of the event the setting for the trophy. Big, bold and iconic without distracting from the World Cup ™.

memories.text: The layout principle for any FIFA World Cup 26™ related items should be created on the tournament grid, which is based on a 16 column grid pattern, as shown in the diagrams in this chapter .

memories.text: If 16 columns do not fit the item, they can be reduced to 8 columns. Switch from 16 to 8 when the 16 columns and the gutter are almost the same width.

memories.text: The longest side of the item is considered X. 4 % of X equals the margins on all 4 edges of the item. The gutter , or space between each column should equal half of the margin, or 2 % of X, as shown on the right.
